TS022 assert-parameters

A function asserts what it expects of its parameters, so a wrong argument fails at the call it came from.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Assert all function arguments and return values, pre/postconditions and invariants. A function must not operate blindly on data it has not checked."
NASA P10 Rule 7: "[...] the validity of parameters must be checked inside each function."
